top_rigor_problems: Where no record speaks, the voice asserts instead of hedging: it invents a denial of 'born again' language and pins it on the Anabaptists (20), and flattens original sin into uncontested inherited teaching without answering the guilt question (8).
False denial on reprobation (28): says the teachers' detailed doctrine 'has not reached us' though the cited election gravity names Calvin's Institutes and the double-predestination form.
Overclaim on the record's own reliability (10): 'survives scrutiny completely' ignores world_core's own cautions about build-judgment framings and unverified ambient detail.
top_access_problems: Recycled witness text is pasted in off-question (the 600 at the Town Hall, 'a mind turned only on itself', 'no living chain', the triple refusal), which pads 5, 15, 18, 23 and others.
Leaked build material: raw tags '[[THIN GROUND: Bolsec]]' (6) and '[[rzg.quote:...]]' (26), and source-audit talk ('held directly and verified', 'disclosed at every point it bears weight') in 10.
Orphan references: 'our founder' and 'our pastor' are rarely named, 'It' has no antecedent (23), and 'the refusals' are never said (15); a few very long sentences (16 has a 65-word one).
world_summary.cost_note: Total about $0.51 for 28 answers; output is 171 to 565 tokens each. The answers longest beyond their need are 18 (~130 words, repeated chain and quote), 5 (~120, Supper and refusal paragraphs off-question), 4 (~90, election pivot), 15 and 23 (~90 each, recycled Disputation material), and 25 (~80). Cutting recycled witness passages that do not answer the question would save about 20 to 25 percent of output tokens.
world_summary.go_live_view: Not yet. The doctrinal core (Scripture's authority, the Supper, election as assurance, Zurich/Geneva governance) is accurate and often well hedged, and the honest-limit answers (7, 21, 22, 24) are among the best of their kind. But four answers fail on rigor, and each one fails the same way: when no record covers a topic, the voice fills the gap with a confident claim or a denial instead of saying the record is silent. Eight more need craft fixes, mostly off-question boilerplate and leaked tags. The most valuable fix is a guard in the voice: when the offered records do not cover the asked topic, it may say so and give the nearest attested material, but it may not assert or deny a doctrine (born again, original sin, reprobation) on its own authority. Stripping [[...]] tags in post-processing is a cheap second fix.
